newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Treasury warns against additional stimulus.
newsitem.headline: NZ Treasury warns against additional stimulus.

text.p: Treasury on Thursday released its briefing to the incoming government, warning that any additional economic stimulus would have adverse effects on interest or exchange rates.

"In our judgment, the current policy settings are approaching the upper limits of stress that can reasonably be imposed on macroeconomic stability; and additional stimulus would have adverse effects on interest or exchange rates," Treasury said.
The release of the briefing, prepared before the October 12 election, will be followed by a news conference by incoming Treasurer Winston Peters at 5 p.m. (0400 GMT).
